verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents an 'API Access & Keys' feature, so a programmatic API exists. The pack has only that page title, though, with no description of what the API covers and no claim that it matches the UI. Probes found no published OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the docs domain, so coverage cannot be checked. Missing for 10: evidence of endpoint coverage across workspaces, documents, agents, users, and admin settings; an explicit API-to-UI parity claim; a published machine-readable API spec; independent or hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
